name: Almiraj
heading: Appendix D / Almiraj
pageNumbering: Printed book folio. The local includes a cover before its numbered contents, so the viewer page is one greater.
appearanceSource: P. 211 text and illustration show a rabbit with a 1-ft. spiral horn. Fur color and the portrait pose are editorial.
habitatSource: P. 211 places these animals in Chult and earthen burrows. Appendix B p. 194 lists them in jungle and ruins.
sourceDistinctions: The block is Small even though the prose calls the creature a large rabbit. The familiar form requires DM permission.
Official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 gives no change to this creature block.

name: Brontosaurus
heading: Appendix D / Brontosaurus
pageNumbering: Printed book folio. The local includes a cover before its numbered contents, so the viewer page is one greater.
appearanceSource: P. 215 describes an immense four-legged dinosaur with a dangerous tail. Neck, coloration and profile details are editorial sauropod anatomy.
habitatSource: Appendix B p. 194 places the brontosaurus among the jungle, river and swamp encounters.
sourceDistinctions: Both Stomp and Tail have a printed reach of 20 ft. The printed action list has no Multiattack.
Official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 gives no change to this creature block.

name: Deinonychus
heading: Appendix D / Deinonychus
pageNumbering: Printed book folio. The local includes a cover before its numbered contents, so the viewer page is one greater.
appearanceSource: P. 217 describes a larger relative of Velociraptor that grips prey with its claws. Color, scales and other visual details are editorial and match the selected portrait.
habitatSource: Appendix B p. 194 lists jungle and ruin encounters in Chult.
sourceDistinctions: The September 2017 Pounce needs a straight 20-ft. approach and a Claw hit on the same turn. The target’s DC 12 save is Strength, and the follow-up is one bonus-action Bite if the target is prone.
Official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 gives no change to this creature block.

name: Dimetrodon
heading: Appendix D / Dimetrodon
pageNumbering: Printed book folio. The local includes a cover before its numbered contents, so the viewer page is one greater.
appearanceSource: P. 217 supplies the sail-backed reptile silhouette. Color, muzzle, tail and ribbed sail details are editorial.
habitatSource: P. 217 specifies shores and shallow water. Appendix B pp. 194 and 197 add the beach, river, swamp and riverbank context.
sourceDistinctions: The stat block gives a swim speed. It does not list Hold Breath. The Constitution score is 15 (+2), visually checked on the page.
Official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 gives no change to this creature block.

name: Flying Monkey
heading: Appendix D / Flying Monkey
pageNumbering: Printed book folio. The local includes a cover before its numbered contents, so the viewer page is one greater.
appearanceSource: The p. 220 illustration shows the wings and monkey body. P. 221 gives a range of colors and about a 5-ft. spread of feathered wings. The selected colors are editorial.
habitatSource: Appendix B p. 194 lists beach, jungle, mountain, river, and ruin encounters. Mountain forests is an editorial search label for mountain habitat.
sourceDistinctions: P. 220 holds the stat block, with descriptive text continued on p. 221. The swoop and training rules belong to the p. 200 encounter, outside the printed stat block.
Official Tomb of Annihilation errata v2.0 gives no change to this creature block.
